_schema._comment: case-reconcile PROPOSE output (MCS-17/MCS-38). Machine drafts, human promotes -- nothing here is written into standards_spine.json or cases_index.json until `reconcile.py --confirm "<title>"` is run by name. possible_revision_of flags a title that fuzzy-matches an EXISTING spine case (e.g. a v2 of an already-tagged case) -- resolve that by hand before confirming; the matcher will not guess.

_promotion: Sign-off-gated: run `reconcile.py --confirm "<title>"` to promote one case's proposed skills into standards_spine.json.cases[]/covered_by[] and add it to cases_index.json. Never automatic.
